picks.rationale: The studio behind the world's biggest kids' channel formally tells its own artists to start using AI — the clearest signal yet of how animation job descriptions are being rewritten.
picks.excerpt: Moonbug Entertainment, which makes Cocomelon, Blippi, and other popular content for children, says it will begin using AI but will always have a 'human in the loop.'

picks.rationale: A concrete NLE release editors can act on this week: Shared Projects changes, new AI tools and Ready to Edit land in Media Composer ahead of IBC2026.
picks.excerpt: Media Composer 2026.8 adds Shared Projects options, AI tools and Ready to Edit ahead of IBC2026.

picks.rationale: Netflix putting a digitally resurrected Gene Wilder on camera as a series host moves synthetic likeness from experiment to mainstream format — and sets the tone for the backlash.
picks.excerpt: The competition series trailer features the digitally resurrected Wilder as host and one of the original Oompa Loompa actors.

picks.rationale: An inside look at how a script-to-storyboard-to-generate-to-revise pipeline collapses a whole short-drama crew into one operator — the most concrete picture of an AI-native production workflow in the pool.
picks.excerpt: Former animators, cinematographers, and VFX artists are helping build AI systems that can script, storyboard, generate, and revise short dramas with unprecedented speed.

picks.rationale: On-device 3DGS scanning with no cloud round-trip and a free tier makes location and prop capture a same-day previs habit rather than a pipeline project.
picks.excerpt: New iOS app generates 3DGS scans of objects and environments entirely on your phone, without cloud processing. The base app is free.
